description: A white plastic base with two upright pillars sits on a yellow surface, with a separate white connector piece lying to the right. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the connector as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it leftward over the base while the left hand hovers near the base to steady it, then the right hand lowers and presses the piece down into the right-side slot between the pillars before releasing.
